purpose: Non-admission discovery of cross-domain Europe sources (building energy, surfaces, permits, industrial sites, economy, infrastructure, heritage, materials, lights) useful for catastrophe-model exposure and vulnerability validation, never an approved modeling-input list.

entries.name: JRC Digital Building Stock Model DBSM R2025
entries.spatial_scope: EU27 including outermost island regions (not full EUBUCCO Europe scope)
entries.temporal_scope: R2025 data release catalogued in 2026, building data vintages differ by source
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual building polygons and height, compactness, construction epoch, building use, rooftop solar-PV potential
entries.note: DBSM R2025 publisher states ODbL v1.0. Footprints/attributes may derive from OSM, Microsoft, European Settlement Map and other common inputs with EUBUCCO and Overture; not independent ground truth. Roof PV POTENTIAL is not installed panel ownership or insured value. Keep polygon relationship, source lineage, time and model confidence.

entries.name: Copernicus HRL Imperviousness Density 2024
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Sentinel-2 derived 10 m and 100 m raster percent sealed-surface fraction, EPSG:3035; companion confidence product
entries.note: This is proportion of impervious surface, not a list of buildings, water depth or sewer/drainage capacity. Product page currently notes validation pending. The separate Impervious Built-Up 2024 binary layer is already catalogued, do not count it as independent external truth.

entries.name: Copernicus HRL Tree Cover Density 2018-present 10m yearly
entries.temporal_scope: Annual imagery-based layers from 2018, actual regional acquisition vintages differ
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Sentinel-1/2-derived continuous tree canopy density fraction at 10m with confidence-layer products
entries.note: Canopy density is a proxy for vegetation, not combustible biomass, exact tree height, fire intensity or tree fall probability. Raster time must align with building footprint and hazard event dates. Tree/forest type layers can share sensor/model inputs.

entries.name: Copernicus HRL Forest Type 2018-present 10m
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 10m raster broadleaved/coniferous/non-forest classes derived from tree cover and leaf type data
entries.note: Tree species classification alone cannot determine fire susceptibility, vegetation loss or actual fuel load; correlate with climate/humidity and avoid independent-evidence claims against other CLMS tree products.

entries.name: France SDES Sitadel urbanism building, extension and demolition permits
entries.provider: Service des données et études statistiques / French Ministry of Ecological Transition
entries.spatial_scope: France with coverage by published administrative areas and exact product
entries.temporal_scope: 2013-present permits, published monthly; Sitadel3 replaces Sitadel2 for new output from March 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Reported granted building permits, prior declarations, residential/nonresidential creation, extensions and demolition permissions
entries.note: Permitted works are not proof of completion, occupation, built geometry or demolition. Exact geolocation/address availability and privacy fields must be checked per product before RNB/BDNB linkage; at minimum use published commune aggregates. Sitadel2 to Sitadel3 methodology/revision creates time-series break.

entries.name: Destatis GENESIS building permits construction and material statistics 31111
entries.temporal_scope: Historical years to present, periodically updated
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official construction permit and planned construction costs, floors, building use and predominant construction-material tables by administrative statistical scope
entries.note: Aggregated permits, not verified building-level footprints or completed structures. Construction-cost table values are planned costs under survey definitions, not replacement values or insured sums. Preserve classification, administrative boundary and period.

entries.name: EEA Industrial Emissions Portal Europe industrial facilities
entries.provider: European Environment Agency / Member State facility reporting
entries.spatial_scope: EEA and EU industrial reporting countries
entries.temporal_scope: Regular country reports; E-PRTR / IED v16.0 Feb 2026 documented
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Geocoded industrial complexes with activity type, plant identifiers, waste/emissions and energy context; more than 60k sites in public portal
entries.note: Emissions registry is not complete insured industrial inventory. Only regulated/threshold-reporting sites appear; coordinate may represent site centroid not each building, no verified insured sums or own/legal entity crosswalk. Preserve plant status, facility IDs, country and original rights.

entries.name: NASA Black Marble VIIRS VNP46A2 Version 2 daily nighttime lights
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 15 arc-second roughly 500m daily corrected nocturnal radiance including quality, cloud, lunar and snow flags in HDF5
entries.note: Nightlight radiance is NOT building value, insurer exposure, household wealth, exact workforce or outage ground truth. Respect QA clouds, snow, season, stray light, lunar correction, gap filling and baseline differences. Lights emitted beyond buildings and rural dark sites require careful modelling.

entries.name: Prebuilt European high-voltage electricity network for PyPSA-Eur Version 0.6
entries.provider: Xiong, Fioriti, Neumann, Riepin, Brown / TU Berlin collaborators
entries.spatial_scope: Multiple European countries according to v0.6 release
entries.temporal_scope: Open version 0.6 published November 2024, underlying OSM observation snapshot
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Topologically connected 220–750 kV AC and DC power network, substations, buses and modeled lines with OSM identifiers
entries.note: Not an up-to-date verified operator topology or local low-voltage distribution grid; OSM edits and heuristic corrections mean missing/disconnected links. Buses may merge substations within 500m. Use synthetic outage simulations only after checking network rights, electrical parameters and uncertainty.

entries.name: European Landslide Susceptibility Map ELSUS v2
entries.provider: European Commission JRC / ESDAC and scientific collaborators
entries.spatial_scope: EU except Malta plus several surrounding European countries
entries.temporal_scope: 2018 scientific version, calibration from heterogeneous historic landslide inventories
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Continental-scale generic landslide susceptibility zonation derived from terrain, geology, land cover and past landslide locations
entries.note: Susceptibility is neither annual event occurrence probability, hazard intensity or deterministic individual-building structural failure. Caution about spatial and temporal scale, database bias and model training overlap.

entries.name: National Heritage List for England listed buildings spatial data
entries.temporal_scope: Maintained listings including October 30, 2026 GIS release
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Listed building designations as points/polygons plus status and heritage context downloadable through official Open Data Hub
entries.note: Heritage designation polygon may enclose multiple structures or a site, and a point may not match EUBUCCO building centroid. Listing does not establish actual masonry structure, actual material or replacement price. Heritage-specific conservation rebuild costs require separate evidence.

entries.name: France Mérimée historic protected building registry
entries.provider: Ministère de la Culture / Monuments historiques
entries.spatial_scope: France national and overseas scope per source records
entries.temporal_scope: Historic listings from 1840 onward, official revision dates per record
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Historic monument protection records with building descriptions, roof types, era, some wall materials, administrative locations and cadastre references
entries.note: For protected stock only, not complete structures. Records can represent sites not single buildings; not all fields reliable/complete. Join RNB/BDTOPO geometrically with human review where ID missing. Roof/material descriptions sometimes observed in documentation but cannot be generalized to neighbours.

entries.name: Eurostat residential house price and sales indices
entries.spatial_scope: EU and reporting European statistical countries
entries.temporal_scope: Annual and quarterly national house transaction price series with revisions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: HPI national transaction price indices (base 2015) and number/value of house sales indicator series
entries.note: Transaction market prices include land/location scarcity and are not replacement construction costs, sums insured or building value. No automatic allocation to a specific building. Distinguish from previously proposed Eurostat construction-cost indices.

entries.name: Eurostat regional structural business statistics (NUTS 2021)
entries.spatial_scope: EU regions NUTS2; table-specific country coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Multiannual regional NACE structural business tables; updates and NUTS classification changes
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Enterprise numbers, turnover, personnel costs and industry breakdowns by NUTS2 and NACE Rev.2
entries.note: Reported turnover/revenue does not imply insured BI sum, location of every establishment or physical property assets. Enterprise HQ, local units and branches differ. Honor missing/suppressed cells, NACE industry and NUTS vintage.

entries.name: Eurostat business demography by regional NUTS3 industry/size
entries.spatial_scope: EU and participating NUTS3 regions where released
entries.temporal_scope: Time series and NUTS versions vary; validate exact download code
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Counts of enterprises with employees and age/size by NUTS3 and NACE industry (table-specific)
entries.note: Business count is not directly a geolocated insured site. Cannot infer the location of a firm or asset from NUTS3 aggregate; avoid double counting with NUTS2 SBS and country company registries.

entries.name: EU27 harmonised building material and life-cycle inventory by archetype
entries.provider: Ramon, Pristerà and collaborators / KU Leuven RDR
entries.temporal_scope: 2025 research dataset, vintage by archetype and source
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Life-cycle inventory of material/energy quantities by building archetype and element (wall, roof etc), annual flows and environmental impacts
entries.note: Component-level archetype material volume may support vulnerability and repair-cost priors, not direct evidence of actual materials or values for any building. Do not confuse life-cycle environmental impact accounting with construction/replacement price. Check exact open file licence before reuse.

entries.name: JRC PVGIS 6 geospatial solar radiation and PV performance
entries.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / ECMWF
entries.temporal_scope: PVGIS 6 product, 2026 update with periodic data revisions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Geospatial GeoTIFF radiation/PV output datasets and API for location-specific solar resource and theoretical PV performance
entries.note: Potential generation/radiation does not show installed rooftop arrays or their replacement value. Validate actual PV presence elsewhere; hazard vulnerability differs by installed panel design and mounting. Avoid reusing DBSM PV potential as independent evidence if based on PVGIS.

entries.name: ECB Household Finance and Consumption Survey HFCS public aggregate tables 2021 wave
entries.provider: European Central Bank / Household Finance and Consumption Network
entries.spatial_scope: Euro area and participating European countries
entries.temporal_scope: 2021 survey wave; public statistical tables revised June 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Aggregate sample-distribution tables on housing wealth, financial and tangible assets and household structure
entries.note: Survey-reported home values include location/land, often self-assessed. Aggregate wealth is not insured home/contents sum insured. Microdata access/privacy restrictions apply; build only anonymised aggregate priors, never individual address/property or identifiable household links.
